query: Organize the free-text responses in our customer survey Excel workbook by sentiment, main topic, cancellation signal, and need for staff review. Preserve the original response number.
Every month we receive store-review CSV files from all branches. Summarize recurring praise and complaints by branch and keep each original review ID.
Classify 200,000 inquiries by subject, urgency, responsible team, and need for a callback without losing the case number.
Turn thousands of past support conversations into a short issue summary and a proposed reply for an agent to review before sending.
Analyze guest comments from every hotel, group the recurring service and room issues, and show which properties need a manager to follow up.
Organize thousands of sales notes into customer needs, products of interest, promised next actions, and deadlines that require review.
Group all open-ended campaign responses into themes, explain the evidence for each theme, and retain the respondent code for later review.
Organize our product-request backlog by request type, affected feature, usage scenario, and stated problem, and show how often the same content occurs.
Normalize the titles, brands, and categories in our quarterly product-catalog Parquet files, but leave uncertain specifications blank instead of guessing.
Translate every product description into English, Japanese, and German, preserve each SKU, and use consistent terminology across duplicate descriptions.
Extract supplier name, invoice number, dates, totals, tax, and line items from all invoice PDFs so the accounting team can reconcile them manually.
Compare hundreds of supplier quotes by extracting lead time, minimum quantity, delivery terms, and quoted price into a review table; do not choose a supplier.
Extract parties, start date, renewal date, termination-notice deadline, and source passages from the contract folder so counsel can review the original text.
Classify delivery-delay notes from every warehouse by likely cause, affected step, and suggested owner for an operations coordinator to review.
Organize several years of plant defect notes by component, symptom, production step, and whether recurrence is stated, then list items for quality-team review.
Review all packaging inspection photos and notes, flag visible damage or label problems for a human inspector, and preserve the photo filename.
Route all office maintenance requests by location and issue type, and flag wording that may need urgent coordinator review without dispatching anyone automatically.
Summarize thousands of redacted incident reports into affected service, observed evidence, customer impact, and the team that should review the case.
Use our entire internal knowledge library so that each employee question returns the five articles closest in meaning, not only exact word matches.
Summarize anonymized employee surveys by department and identify common workplace themes without evaluating or ranking individuals.
Analyze all course-feedback forms by topic, clarity, pace, and requested improvements so the training team can revise the next session.
Sort thousands of resident inquiry messages into service area and requested action for staff review, without deciding anyone's eligibility for a benefit.
Extract energy use, emissions, reporting period, unit, and source page from every supplier sustainability report for an analyst to verify.
Organize monthly-close variance explanations into common themes such as price, quantity, timing, and one-time factors while retaining a reference to each explanation.
Some product categories are blank. Use the completed rows as examples, test the accuracy on values we already know, and fill only the blanks that meet the agreed quality target.
Some maintenance failure categories are blank. Use completed records to measure the required example count and accuracy, and leave uncertain rows blank.
Read open cases from our customer-service database, add topic, urgency, and a short summary to a new results table, and leave the source table unchanged.
Before analyzing 300,000 comments, tell me how many unique comments may be sent for processing and estimate the workload so I can approve the cost.
I want to analyze this Excel survey. If an additional component is needed, explain what it adds to my computer and the alternatives, then install it only after I choose.
openaivec says it cannot find valid credentials before analyzing the files. Help me connect without asking me to paste a key or password here.
Our company-approved Azure OpenAI connection returns 403 before any survey rows are processed. Help me fix access without exposing credentials.
Summarize every incident row and replace the original CSV with the result; warn me about any risk to the source before doing it.
After categorizing the archived support cases and saving a new result table, delete only the source rows that were successfully migrated.
Summarize hundreds of store-visit reports into observed issue, supporting evidence, proposed owner, and due-date candidate while retaining each source filename.

Classify survey comments by sentiment and topic, then cross-tab them by department and month. If dept_code could mean the respondent department or the handling department, ask me one question at a time with single-choice options and free-text input.

Classify all return comments, then cross-tab the reasons by market and month. If market could mean shipping country, selling organization, or reporting region, ask me to choose one with a free-text alternative before grouping.
Classify 300,000 inquiries. If it takes a long time, process them efficiently in batches rather than one at a time, and regularly report completed count, percentage, elapsed time, and failures.
Show me the first ten rows of this file without analyzing or changing the text.
Create a cross-tab of the existing numeric unit-sales column by region and month; no classification, extraction, summarization, or other language analysis is needed.
Convert this CSV file to Parquet without classifying, summarizing, extracting, or enriching anything.
Replace every blank discount value with the fixed number 0.
Sort this spreadsheet by date and filter it to the East region.
Change the formulas, colors, charts, and print layout in this workbook.
Set up a new company database and configure user permissions for the analytics team.
Copy these rows unchanged into our order system.
Install an Excel-reading library globally, but do not process any workbook or table.
Transcribe all audio recordings in this directory.
Download these websites and load their pages into our search server.
Train a custom language model from these example files.
Rewrite this single email so it sounds friendlier.
Sum monthly sales by region and draw a bar chart.
Rank all job applicants and automatically recommend who should receive an interview.
Decide which customers qualify for a loan and set their credit limits from these records.
Read patient notes and automatically diagnose each person and select their treatment.
Deploy and configure the network for a new cloud AI service.
Run a Spark UDF over my Fabric Lakehouse table.
